eventMetadata.context_description: With the Western Conference semifinals series tied 2-2, trader consensus reflects a razor-close matchup between the No. 2 seed Spurs and No. 6 seed Timberwolves ahead of Game 5 in San Antonio. Minnesota evened the score in Game 4 on May 10 behind Anthony Edwards' 36 points, capitalizing on Victor Wembanyama's ejection for a flagrant foul that sidelined the Spurs star late. Spurs hold home-court edge and Wembanyama's dominance (39 points in Game 3), but De'Aaron Fox is questionable with right ankle soreness from a Game 4 collision, potentially disrupting backcourt rhythm alongside Dylan Harper's questionable status. Timberwolves miss Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles), leaning on Edwards' playoff form amid back-to-back road tests.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland commands trader consensus at 44.6% implied probability for Eurovision 2026 victory, propelled by Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen's "Liekinheitin"—a string-laden spectacle blending tenderness and high-energy hooks in Finnish—that topped rehearsals and sailed through the first semi-final in Vienna on May 12. The duo's OGAE poll landslide win by over 100 points underscores fan fervor, while consistent bookmaker dominance reflects broad jury and televote appeal. Greece's Akylas with the multilingual "Ferto" (13.2%) and Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund's emotive "Før vi går hjem" (12.3%) chase closely, gaining from rehearsal buzz and streaming traction. As the second semi-final looms May 14 ahead of the May 16 grand final at Wiener Stadthalle, unpredictable jury-televote splits keep upsets viable in this chaotic contest.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
